brief: Add sign-in to the notes app, using the API. Before anything else, show a new sign-in screen with fields labelled "Email" and "Password" and a "Sign in" button. Signing in sends POST /api/session with { email, password }. If the server answers 401, show "Wrong email or password". If it answers with { token }, show the notes list and send that token as an "Authorization: Bearer <token>" header when loading the notes. Keep the token in memory only, never in localStorage, sessionStorage, or cookies. Add a "Sign out" button that goes back to the sign-in screen. Add tests.
